name: Reset Rows Table
purpose: Makes sure the VIRTUALLISTS_Rows table holds exactly 50 numbered rows in sequence: counts the records and checks the sequence, and if either is wrong deletes all records (Truncate Table), resets the serial number to 1 and creates 50 new records. Used as the scaffolding of the virtual list in the picker.
writes:
delete: VIRTUALLISTS_Rows (Truncate Table step 45, all records)
VIRTUALLISTS_Rows::n#1 (Set Next Serial Value step 50, serial reset to 1)
VIRTUALLISTS_Rows (New Record/Request step 56, new record, loop to 50 rows)
open_question: Script runs with full access privileges (runFullAccess=True). Uses Truncate Table, which removes all records of the table without a per-record delete; it is limited to this scaffolding table. The loop exit uses Get(RecordNumber) >= 50 after the new record, which gives 50 rows.

name: Store Virtual List Data ( contactID ; contactName )
purpose: Adds a contact to the virtual list: takes the contact id and name from the parameter (two values) and adds "id|name" to the global array $$VirtualListArray, then updates the found count from the number of picker results. Returns True.
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: No caller found. The comment says the array is a pipe separated list of contact id and name.
